summary: Critical outage in checkout-api caused by disk_full (INC-0013)
description: Service checkout-api incident INC-0013. Symptoms: database write rejections. Error: java.io.IOException: Disk space is full for path /var/lib/postgresql/data. Root cause was disk_full. Followed runbook RB-disk-full.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for checkout-api and applied RB-disk-full.
